When you purchase select products from WD.com, we will automatically upgrade your eligible product to include an extra year of limited warranty coverage1. For example, if the product includes a 2-year limited warranty we will extend it free of charge to a 3-year limited warranty. Select from the qualifying products below to take advantage of this exclusive offer.
No, the limited warranty is extended automatically and is associated with the serial number of your device.
We highly recommend registering your device on the WD Support Site in the event you need support for your device.
You can find all your questions regarding the limited warranty coverage at the link below.

The default limited warranty period varies by product. Please see the Western Digital Support Site for more information on your limited warranty period. The qualifying product you receive will automatically have 1-year added to the default limited warranty period.
For WD click here. For G-DRIVE click here.
For support services or to initiate a return for your product, click on the link for your product brand below to learn more.
For WD click here. For G-DRIVE click here.
At this time, WD does not sell extended warranties.
No. Retailers, Resellers, Distributors and WD for Business customers are excluded from the Extended Limited Warranty program.

Disclosures 1. Offer valid only on qualifying products above, purchased online through WD.com. Offer limited to a maximum of 5 SKUs of the same product per customer. Retailers, Resellers, Distributors and Western Digital Business customers are excluded from this promotion. The offer has no cash value, is not applicable for any prior purchases and may not be available in all regions of the world. WD reserves the right to change or discontinue this offer at any time without notice.
